gui_forms::Panel.summary: Panel is the reusable retained scroll-capable surface primitive with theme-role rendering, explicit background/style overrides, bounded border vocabulary, visual outsets, and optional named-group semantics.
remarks: The reusable retained surface primitive. Theme-role rendering can be overridden by an explicit background or a provisional `BasicControlStyle`; a bounded border vocabulary draws none, line, sunken, or raised frames.
Inherits the full `ScrollableControl` family. A named Panel is exposed as a semantic group; an unnamed structural Panel is not.
gui_forms::Panel.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::Panel.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::Panel.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
